title: Quarterly roadmap: capacity‑aware decision slate for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Develop a quarter-level decision slate that ties Hosted API model lineup decisions to capacity and cost scenarios. The slate will surface prioritized model rotations, capacity hedges, and fallback policies by customer cohort so engineering and sales can coordinate commits and SLAs with predictable economics.
problem_statement: Our current quarterly roadmap for model rotations focuses primarily on feature/quality signals and lacks an explicit mapping to capacity constraints and cost tradeoffs. This causes last-minute swaps, missed SLAs for enterprise customers, and unpredictable billing impact for high-traffic cohorts.
objectives: Define 3 capacity-cost scenarios (Optimistic/Growth/Stress) and associated model lineup decisions
Prioritize model rotations and canary windows by customer cohort (PLG, Mid-market, Enterprise)
Create a clear decision slate that links rollback/fallback policies to capacity signals
Deliver a handoff package for Eng (autoscale policies), Console (dashboards), and Sales (commit messaging)
proposed_milestones: 2026-02-28: Scenario modelling complete (token demand forecasts + cost curves)
2026-03-07: Cross-functional decision slate review (Eng, Console, Sales, SRE)

2026-03-21: Implementation tickets created for autoscale/policy changes
2026-03-31: Handoff docs and playbook published; exec summary for GTM
acceptance_criteria: Three named scenarios with quantitative thresholds (RPS, token/sec, cost per 1M tokens)
Decision slate lists model rotations with cohort mapping and fallback policy for each rotation
Eng tickets include autoscale policy changes and regression guardrails
Console dashboard mockups show per-cohort capacity headroom and projected cost impact
Sales/CS have one-pager commit messaging for enterprise cohorts

risks: Model swap regressions causing quality dips for key enterprise customers
Autoscale/rollback automation not tested in stress conditions leading to oscillation
Mis-aligned incentives: cost-optimized fallbacks might degrade product experience for PLG users
Dashboard telemetry lag could cause delayed decision triggers

Follow-up: Console to add 'predicted cost delta' to rollout UI for visibility during canaries.
Prepare exec one-pager with scenarios and recommended commit lanes for next GTM sync.
